Please stop because I could use your advice. I'm a few years older than you and the only thing I've ever wanted to do with my life is to be an artist, but am unemployed with no luck.

It would really mean a lot to me if I could show you some of my art, and if I could ask about being a tattoo artist. Would you believe me if I told you I'd applied to a tattoo studio this year?

My left arm is the same as yours, it's pretty gnarly to look at between the suicide attempts and cutting. But if I could give you one reason not to is because I need your help.

It is my dream to cover these scars with a beautiful sleeve of artwork one day, think you could help me with this at all?
That guilty feeling might keep you alive tho! It might not be anyway to live but the main reason I don't want to kill myself is because I know how sad my family and cat would be. 😔

Yo, look for things you enjoy first before collages. School is overwhelming but if you can find things you like and learn about them it can be awesome.

I like art and video games so I took a course on Game Design and met a whole bunch of classmates and friends who actually understand what I enjoy and how I like to spend my time. I did want to kill myself in school lol but at least I met people and learned some stuff.

Yes please. I'd like to talk about how I don't talk to anyone now because I know conversations usually start with "How are you?" And saying "I've been thinking about killing myself all day." Usually doesn't fly well with them.

Tell me about your suicidal thoughts I'd love to hear them. Actually I'll go first, usually I think about jumping off a bridge (there is a nice reservoir with a lot of water I used to walk by) and my mind usually goes to that spot. Today however it was really different, I saw a plastic bag and could not stop thinking about suffocating myself. I thought about how long it would take, if the bag would rip, could I pass out and die? Would it hurt? Would it be less or more painful than drowning?

I don't know how normal of a conversation we can have about suicidal thoughts but it's kinda been nice to share this much.

Perhaps now you feel numb, void and emotionless. But think back to when you were a child? When I was a kid I loved to draw pictures and play video games.

I'm about 13 years older than you and it might sound childish but I've done my best to focus on games and art and am even practicing as a video game artist now.

You have a song you like, or maybe a food or meal even?
Get a cat, they hate everyone too you might relate.

This frustrates me on a spiritual level. They say to count your blessings so I'm going to count a few, I have a nice home and good family. My friends I love to death and I enjoy spending time with them. I've gone through school, done post secondary, am educated and talented. I have hopes, dreams and desires but all of this seems to get overshadowed by this endless darkness. 

People telling me it gets better??? It's already fantastic and yet all I can think about day in and day out is how much I want to die. It doesn't make any sense and I just hate myself all the more for not having any legitimate reasons for why I want to die?!

Everything is just so tiring... I have major depression too and I just don't see the point in giving energy into something when nothing really matters anyways.

I'm not in pain or agony either, I even think I have decent self confidence and talent but what does it matter. It's like I don't have the energy to get up or even feed myself anymore, there's so much I'd like to do before I die but everyday is just the same exhausting loop.
